starter_deck.name: Hustle Culture Prophet
starter_deck.description: You turn your love of baking into a joyless, on-demand cupcake delivery service. You haven't touched flour for fun in six months.
starter_deck.flavor_text: Rise and grind... and cry.

choices.text: Fulfill the orders (+200 Money, -10 Mental Health)

starter_deck.name: Protect the Passion
starter_deck.description: Your friend suggests you sell your beautiful watercolor paintings on Etsy. You politely decline, keeping this one thing for yourself.
starter_deck.flavor_text: Not everything needs to be a business.

starter_deck.name: The Algorithm Giveth...
starter_deck.description: Your goofy video of knitting a sweater for your cat goes unexpectedly viral. You are now a knitting influencer.
starter_deck.flavor_text: The attention is nice. The pressure is not.

starter_deck.name: Commodified Self-Care
starter_deck.description: Feeling burnt out, you buy a $90 face serum that promises to 'restore your inner radiance.' You post it on Instagram.
starter_deck.flavor_text: Is it working if no one sees it?

starter_deck.name: Actual Self-Care
starter_deck.description: Instead of 'healing,' you admit you're just tired. You cancel your plans, turn off your phone, and go to bed at 9 p.m.
starter_deck.flavor_text: The radical act of doing nothing.

starter_deck.name: Wellness Influencer Feud
starter_deck.description: Your favorite mindfulness guru is exposed for putting lead in their supplements. The entire wellness community is at war.
starter_deck.flavor_text: So much for inner peace.

starter_deck.name: The Photo Dump
starter_deck.description: You spend four hours curating a 10-slide Instagram carousel of 'candid' blurry photos to prove how carefree and real you are.
starter_deck.flavor_text: Effortless, right?

choices.text: Post the dump (+15 Clout, -5 Mental Health)

starter_deck.name: Log Off
starter_deck.description: You have a genuinely wonderful experience and feel no compulsion to document it for strangers on the internet.
starter_deck.flavor_text: Some things are just for you.

starter_deck.name: Accidental Front-Facing Camera
starter_deck.description: You open your phone in public and are confronted with the uncurated, gremlin-like reality of your own face. It's humbling.
starter_deck.flavor_text: A moment of pure, unfiltered truth.

starter_deck.name: Doomscroll & Dissociate
starter_deck.description: You read about impending ecological collapse while simultaneously ordering a plastic-wrapped salad to your door via a gig-economy app.
starter_deck.flavor_text: At least the salad is healthy.

choices.text: Enjoy your salad (-10 Mental Health, +5 Money)

starter_deck.name: Touch Grass
starter_deck.description: Overwhelmed by the news, you leave your phone at home and go for a walk. The world is still on fire, but the trees are nice.
starter_deck.flavor_text: It's surprisingly effective.

choices.text: Go for a walk (+15 Mental Health)

starter_deck.name: The Notification
starter_deck.description: Your phone buzzes. Is it a catastrophic news alert, a 50% off pizza coupon, or a text from your mom asking for your Netflix password again?
starter_deck.flavor_text: The Schrödinger's cat of modern life.

starter_deck.name: Defend Your Queen
starter_deck.description: Your favorite influencer is getting 'cancelled' for a minor infraction. You spend your entire evening fighting with anonymous troll accounts in their comment section.
starter_deck.flavor_text: They'd do the same for you. Probably.

choices.text: Go to war (+5 Clout, -10 Mental Health)

starter_deck.name: A Moment of Clarity
starter_deck.description: You realize the YouTuber you watch every day to fall asleep doesn't know you exist. You decide to call an actual friend instead.
starter_deck.flavor_text: Real connection is a two-way street.

starter_deck.name: The Unfollowing
starter_deck.description: A beloved online personality suddenly deletes all their social media accounts, leaving a void in the lives of millions... and your daily routine.
starter_deck.flavor_text: It feels weirdly personal.

starter_deck.name: Emergency Vet Visit
starter_deck.description: Your pet needs emergency surgery. The bill is $3000.
starter_deck.flavor_text: Your furry friend is counting on you.

choices.text: Find a cheaper vet (-$1500, -1 Mental Health)
Can't afford it (-3 Mental Health, +2 Sin)

starter_deck.name: Quiet Quitting
starter_deck.description: You consciously decide to do only the work specified in your job description, reclaiming your evenings and weekends.
starter_deck.flavor_text: Act your wage.

starter_deck.name: The Tyranny of the Group Chat
starter_deck.description: A friend adds you to a new group chat for a party that happened three weeks ago. It is now exclusively for sending memes.
starter_deck.flavor_text: You can never leave.

choices.text: Mute the chat forever. (+5 Mental Health)
Become the main meme contributor. (+5 Clout)

starter_deck.name: A Bleak Victory
starter_deck.description: The government has paused student loan payments for another month. This is the best financial news you've had all year.
starter_deck.flavor_text: It's sad that this counts as a win.

starter_deck.name: Main Character Syndrome
starter_deck.description: You romanticize your trip to the grocery store, complete with an internal monologue and imagining the perfect soundtrack.
starter_deck.flavor_text: Everyone else is just an NPC.

starter_deck.name: Cringe is Dead
starter_deck.description: You see someone do something genuinely embarrassing in public. Instead of judging, you feel a sense of solidarity.
starter_deck.flavor_text: To be human is to be cringe.
